description: An image captcha, inline or stacked large above the answer, with an optional audio version and a refresh button. Or Cloudflare Turnstile, reCAPTCHA or hCaptcha, checked on the server with the Captcha rule. In Livewire the image (or the provider's widget) stays put through every render, so the code being answered never changes under you.

consider.note: Check the answer on the server on every submit (the `Captcha` rule), and keep provider secrets in `.env`. A captcha slows bots; it doesn't replace rate limiting or authorization.
Each provider check is a call to another server, and some bill past a free tier. Consider it only where abuse happens (sign-up, contact, password reset), or only after a few failed tries.
